name: czl-triprism-data-team
description: A gated, evidence-first data analysis team for spreadsheets. It grades the table before analysing it, freezes a metric contract so every lane divides by the same denominator, runs trend / composition / integrity analysis in parallel, recomputes every claim from the source file, and delivers an HTML report, a one-pager, a slide deck and an Excel workbook. Fully local, no third-party Python dependencies.

displayName.zh: 三棱镜·专业数据分析专家团

displayDescription.zh: 一份表格进，三路并行会诊：先体检定可信度，再冻口径，走势/拆解/验伤同时分析，每条结论回原表复算，交付四件套。
displayDescription.en: One spreadsheet in, three parallel reviews out: triage, frozen metrics, trend / composition / integrity lanes, every claim recomputed, four deliverables.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一份经营会诊：这份销售表 trends.xlsx，走势、结构、异常都要，最后给我能直接开会用的报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a business review on trends.xlsx - trend, composition and anomalies - and give me a report I can take into a meeting.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份经营会诊：这份销售表 trends.xlsx，走势、结构、异常都要，最后给我能直接开会用的报告
quickPrompts.en: Run a business review on trends.xlsx - trend, composition and anomalies - and give me a report I can take into a meeting.

quickPrompts.zh: 先告诉我这张表能不能用，能支撑多强的结论：orders.csv
quickPrompts.en: First tell me whether orders.csv is usable and how strong a conclusion it can support.

quickPrompts.zh: 最近三个月成本涨得不对，帮我查是不是数据问题：cost_detail.xlsx
quickPrompts.en: Cost looks wrong for the last three months - check whether it is a data problem: cost_detail.xlsx
